item.text:
Fixed ACCESS-284. Permissions now traverse parent roles, so auditors inherit `report:download` from `report-reader`.

Removed the analyst shortcut: analysts retain inherited access, and explicit denials are respected. Traversal safely handles cycles and missing roles.

All 5 tests pass, including the auditor regression. `git diff --check` passes.
